name: @cmorales_/vite-plugin-html-template
description: `@cmorales_/vite-plugin-html-template` is a plugin for vite and mainly for 'Vanilla' (without specific framework, like React.js, Vue, Svelte, ...), with witch you can define within the `<template>` tag as a component, then you can use the `<x-template>` tag (customizable) and also add HTML attributes (class, data-*, style, aria-*)
